facts: Parties: Ashcombe Analytics Ltd (Buyer), Dunmore Technologies Ltd (Seller); the Company is Calloway Industries Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 19 September 2026; Closing is scheduled for 1 November 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $2,100,000 (1.0% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Delamere Marine Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
